description:
Rescoped 2026-11-27 (owner decisions 1-3). Deliver on library PR #5: (a) pin tpcdsgen/tpcdsgen-arrow to a BenchBox-dev/tpcgen-rs commit that is exactly upstream v4.0.0 plus PR #677 (Scaling::with_row_counts, SessionBuilder::with_scaling) via `[patch.crates-io]`, route SF < 1 through upstream generators with the patched-dsdgen scale model, and delete the own generators in `crates/benchbox-datagen-core/src/dsgen/` and the DAT-to-Arrow path; (b) keep the scale model (row_counts, key_ranges, table_scales, rowcount gate fixture) and TPC-H refresh sets; (c) move `tpcds_update/` out to datagen-lib-tpcds-refresh-sets.

## Decision gates
- If the carried patch does not give byte identity for all 24 tables at every sub-scale (the probe passed; two wrapper-clamp cases, customer_address and web_page at SF 0.05, must be re-checked), stop and report which table fails and why; do not fall back to own generators without the owner.
- If the patch must grow beyond about 200 changed lines, stop and bring sizes to the owner.

## Guardrails
- The fork branch contains only upstream v4.0.0 plus the #677 commits; pinned by full commit SHA; README lists the patch and its upstream PR.
- SF >= 1 output must stay byte-identical. No tracker writes by subagents; heavy work only under make heavy-run; no pkill by pattern.
